biotools.summary: Locuaz is a computational platform for optimizing protein binders, enabling mutation selection, molecular dynamics simulations, and prioritization for in silico high-throughput screening. It supports parallel exploration of mutation streams and is highly customizable, with documentation and source code available on GitHub and Read the Docs.
